summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A., an Argentine real estate company, reporting the exercise of warrants by holders between May 11-12, 2026. A total of 35,318,802 ordinary shares were issued at ARS 10 face value (approximately ARS 353 million), generating USD 459,146 in proceeds. Post-exercise, outstanding shares rose from 810,797,120 to 846,115,922, with 149,100 warrants remaining unexercised and expiring on May 12, 2026. The filing is a standard capital-structure update, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural complexity is involved.
